# Latetwenties

> Latetwenties is an Auckland based local marketing agency for home service
> businesses across New Zealand and Australia. We get builders and trades
> found on Google, Maps and AI search, so the calls come to them. We treat the website, the Google Business Profile, the
> listings, the reviews and the advertising as one connected system, and we
> treat the business owner like a person, not a dashboard.

Founder: Brendan MacDonald
Based: Auckland, New Zealand
Working: New Zealand and Australia
Email: team@latetwenties.agency
Phone: +64-9-884-4418
Hours: Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm NZT
Website: https://latetwenties.agency

## What we do

Three steps, one goal: more of the right enquiries, and proof of where every
one came from. No lock-in contract.

- **Onboarding**: one kick-off call about the jobs you want more of. We write
  every word on the site and source the images; the owner uploads their
  project photos once.
- **Groundwork**: we map where the real demand is in your area, service by
  service and town by town, then build to win it: a fast website with a page
  for every job, Google Business Profile, listings, a review system, and call
  and form tracking. Google Ads too, if they suit. Live in two to four weeks.
- **Upkeep**: each month we keep it working: new pages, Google posts, reviews
  kept moving, Google Ads managed, and fixes. You get a short monthly report
  and walkthrough video: how many enquiries came in, what they cost and which
  ones turned into work.

Free search: run the search your customer runs and see who gets the call in
your area, on Google, Maps and AI. About 40 seconds, no sign-up.
https://latetwenties.agency/local-search-check

## Who we work with

Home service businesses, owner-led, close to the work: builders, concreters,
electricians, plumbers, roofers, landscapers and other trades, across New
Zealand and Australia. Usually established on referrals, with capacity for
more work and no reliable flow of enquiries from search.

Every client named and real, numbers theirs, receipts on the page.

**Boaz Developments** (builders, Mangawhai, Northland NZ)
From not showing on the Google map pack (average rank 10.1) to #2 across
the neighbouring towns, in under two months.

## Frequently asked

**How long until it's live?** Two to four weeks from onboarding to launch.
The first week is research, then the build. Upkeep starts the day it goes
live.

**Where do Google Ads fit?** On top of the groundwork, when you want calls
sooner. The page an ad lands on decides whether a click becomes a call, so we
run ads alongside the site and Google profile, not instead of them.

**Do you work outside Auckland?** Yes, across New Zealand and Australia.
What matters is your patch and how people search in it.

**Can you get me into ChatGPT?** We can help, but nobody can promise a spot.
We set up Bing Places, match your listings and write pages that answer real
questions, then check where you show up.

**Do I own everything?** Yes. Website, domain, Google Business Profile,
every account we set up, all in your name.

**Am I locked in?** No. There's no lock-in contract. You stay because it's working.

## How we work

Manaakitanga is the operating value. A Māori value about how people care
for each other. Mana (a person's standing, dignity, spirit) joined with aki
(to uplift or support). It's about the owner across the table, not the
business in front of them. We listen properly. We carry your reputation
with the same care you would. The work follows from that.

We aim to be the marketing partner you forget about, in the good way. We do
the work, we show our working, and we only pull you in when we genuinely
need a decision only you can make. Each month you get a single page or a
short Loom: what's been done, what's changed, what's next.

## Voice

Plain-spoken, NZ-grounded. No hype, no jargon, no marketing fluff. We treat
your business with the same seriousness you treat it yourself. Honest about
what's working and what isn't. Wins celebrated. Bits that aren't landing
said out loud, not hidden under a softer chart.

## What we don't do

- Lock-in contracts
- Hourly billing
- Suburb-specific landing pages designed only for SEO
- Pitch decks and wireframe sign-offs before a build
- Stock photography on case studies
- Composite or anonymous "results"
- Vague reporting that hides what isn't working
